risks.risk: The part may be damaged or non-functional, with internal wear or leaks not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video showing the part being tested or a close-up of internal components (e.g., gears, fluid lines) under inspection.

risks.risk: The part may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle, or may be from a different make/model than expected.
